_comment: Default Claudex config — defaultMode 'bypassPermissions' runs every tool call without prompting. This is required for a headless Telegram agent: there is no terminal where a human can approve prompts, so a prompting mode would hang the session. scripts/bootstrap.sh pre-approves the two one-time first-run gates for you (see README 'Permissions & Safety'). For the same setup WITH a deny safety net + inline docs, copy templates/settings.json.example instead.

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)" && git add -A 2>/dev/null || true
